name: Cox's Bazar
description: Follow the curve of the world's longest natural sea beach, where golden sand, fishing boats and a wide-open horizon set an easy pace.
specialty: A 120 km stretch of unbroken shoreline

images.alt: Golden-hour light over Cox's Bazar sea beach

transit.Bus: Frequent overnight and daytime coaches run from Dhaka to Cox's Bazar.
transit.Train: Take a train to Chattogram, then continue by road to the coast.
transit.Flight: Domestic flights connect Dhaka with Cox's Bazar Airport.

name: Sajek Valley
description: Wake above a sea of clouds in the Chittagong Hill Tracts, where quiet ridgelines and small hillside communities reward a slower journey.

images.alt: A view across the hills of Sajek Valley

transit.Bus: Travel to Khagrachari by bus; local shared vehicles continue to Sajek.
transit.Train: There is no direct train. Reach Chattogram by rail and continue by road.
transit.Flight: Fly to Chattogram, then arrange onward road transport.

name: The Sundarbans
description: Drift through tidal waterways beneath a vast mangrove canopy, in a living landscape shaped by the rhythm of river and sea.

images.alt: A fisherman travelling by boat through the Sundarbans

transit.Bus: Buses connect Dhaka with Khulna; guided boat trips depart from nearby launch points.
transit.Train: Take a train from Dhaka to Khulna, then connect with an organized river tour.
transit.Flight: Fly to Jessore and continue by road to Khulna.

name: Sylhet Tea Gardens
description: Take the scenic road through rolling tea estates, misty slopes and forest-fringed trails in Bangladesh's green northeast.

images.alt: Curving rows of tea bushes in the Sylhet tea country

transit.Bus: Direct coach services run from Dhaka to Sylhet throughout the day.
transit.Train: Intercity trains connect Dhaka and Sylhet; local transport reaches the estates.
transit.Flight: Daily domestic flights connect Dhaka with Osmani International Airport.

name: Sreemangal
description: A gentle escape into tea country, with forest trails, rain-washed gardens and a famously unhurried small-town feel.

images.alt: Tea gardens rolling over the hills of Sreemangal

transit.Bus: Coaches to Sreemangal and nearby Moulvibazar run from Dhaka and Sylhet.
transit.Train: Intercity trains from Dhaka stop at Sreemangal station.
transit.Flight: Fly to Sylhet, then continue around 80 km by road.

name: Sonargaon
description: Step into Bengal's past among old merchant houses, riverside lanes and the restored timber architecture of Panam City.
specialty: The atmospheric merchant street of Panam City

images.alt: Historic merchant houses on the old street of Panam City

transit.Bus: Local buses and rideshare services connect central Dhaka with Sonargaon.
transit.Train: Take a train to Dhaka, then continue by road to the historic town.
transit.Flight: Fly to Dhaka and travel onward by road.

name: Tanguar Haor
description: Sail across a shimmering freshwater haor, where floating villages and seasonal birdlife turn the horizon into open water.

images.alt: Silhouettes of trees reflected in the wide water of Tanguar Haor

transit.Bus: Travel to Sunamganj by bus from Sylhet, then arrange local boat transport.
transit.Train: Take a train to Sylhet and continue to Sunamganj by road.
transit.Flight: Fly to Sylhet and travel onward by road to the haor.

name: Lalbagh Fort
description: Find a moment of calm inside Old Dhaka's unfinished Mughal fortress, framed by graceful gardens and centuries-old brickwork.

images.alt: Brick gateway and gardens at Lalbagh Fort in Dhaka

transit.Bus: Local buses and rideshare services reach Old Dhaka from across the city.
transit.Train: Arrive at Dhaka railway station and continue by local transport.
transit.Flight: Fly to Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport; the fort is in central Dhaka.
